decision_conditions:
The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 

EF LP Rev 1, EK 100 EL rev 1, EK 100 GA rev 1, EK 200 GA rev 1, EK 200 EL rev 1, AH 300 LUL, EK 300 KE Delivery and Servicing Management Plan, Kitchen Extraction System details reference EK KE 01 dated June 2017

REASON: To comply with Section 70(1)(a) of the Town and Country Act 1990 as amended and the Reason for Grant and also for the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
description:
Section 73 Application for the removal/variation of condition 9 of planning consent ref: P2017/2049/FUL dated 27/09/2017, which granted full planning permission for a change of use of unit 2 from existing A1 retail into 1 no mixed A3 restuarant/ A4 class public house .The proposals include the internal refurbishment of the site,  the design of a new shop front and associated plant equipment.

The application seeking to amend of the hours of operation condition to following :

Sunday to Thursday until 1:00 a.m.
Friday and Saturday until 3:00 a.m.
